::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 19th [1887]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection
:::

Dear [Sir](people/person_448.qmd)[^1]

I think it would be well to send me a set of sheets of What to Read, that I might add to them or cancel them on occasion. I know there are some good books of this winter not added, and [Goldhanger Woods](other_books/otherbook_1024.qmd),[^2] and I have not seen a sheet since before Christmas. I am afraid the books may be forgotten and omitted if I do not set them down soon

Yours &c
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Duncan was her usual correspondent at the [National Society](organizations/other_32.qmd), the publishers of *What Books to Lend and What to Give* (1887), but she usually called him Mr Duncan.
[^2]: Mary and Catherine Lee, *Goldhanger Woods: A Child's Romance* (London: National Society 1886). Mary Lee had collaborated with CMY on *The Miz Maze* (1883).
